pages.text: The chirping of cicadas in Shenzhen in August is louder than imagined. The air is filled with the salty humidity of the ocean and the bitter taste of the asphalt road that has been sun-stained. This is the first impression "The Nameless Sea" gave to Lin Du.

Lin Du dragged his heavy suitcase and stood at the gate of The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen. The building lines in front of you are sharp and modern, like a rigorous precision instrument.

Not far away, several students wearing dark blue volunteer vests were walking among the crowd. A senior who looked a little tired wearing black-rimmed glasses noticed Lin Du who was looking at the map.
Classmate, are you a freshman? Don't look at the map, it's for foreign guests. If you want to go to the check-in point, keep going up this slope.
Thank you, senior. Excuse me...is that the gymnasium over there where you can register and get your card?
right. Go ahead before there are any long lines. By the way, your campus card is your lifeblood. You rely on it to eat, get in, print lectures, and even grab a seat in the library.

Lin Du walked in the direction pointed by the senior. Under the scorching sun, he felt as if he was entering some kind of huge system. Every student he passed by was walking in a hurry, as if there was an invisible countdown behind him.
In the gymnasium, the air-conditioning and noise hit at the same time. Lin Du Stand still in front of the check-in window.
Name, ID number.
Lin Du. 440...
Lin Du took the thin plastic card and could still feel the residual warmth left by the card-making machine on his fingertips.
When he returned to the school gate again, the senior student just now was sitting on the steps drinking water. He turned to look at Lin Du with an indescribable scrutiny in his eyes.
Got the card? Congratulations, you have officially become a part of this precision machine.
Senior, why does everyone look so... anxious?
urgent? This is just a warm-up. Lin Du, you will understand later - many people think that college is a haven in life and the end of hard work.
But here, university is just a magnifying glass.
It will magnify your ambition and your mediocrity. It will cut your anxiety into pieces and cram it into every second of the class schedule.
Thank you, senior, for the reminder. I will try my best to adapt to the rhythm here.
Sounds like survivor exaggeration, I'll see it through in my own way.
Oh, quite energetic. Go to the dormitory. The road to the garden is not easy to walk. Remember to protect your knees.

Lin Du Dragging his luggage, he stepped onto the elevator leading to the Upper Garden. As the height climbs, the outline of the teaching building shrinks in the field of vision, while the sea in the distance becomes clear.
Downstairs in the dormitory, an aunt with a neat ponytail and a notepad was guarding the gate.
Stop and swipe your card. New here?
Hello aunt, I am Lin Du from Building C 402.

The names matched. This is the dormitory key. Listen up, the use of high-power electrical appliances is prohibited in the dormitory, and the door will be closed after twelve o'clock in the evening. Also, if you want to hang out here, change places as soon as possible.
...Is it difficult to get by here?

Every morning at six o'clock, someone in this building will get up and memorize vocabulary. At three o'clock in the morning, there were still people discussing group assignments in the corridor. What do you think?
The aunt ignored him and continued to check the list with her head down. Lin Du Walking into the room, the narrow but neat space will be her stronghold for the next four years.
She sat down at the desk, took out her phone as prompted, and scanned the QR code on the corner of the desk.
"Welcome to the campus intelligent system. Please bind your personal identity and the system will automatically generate the first week's class schedule for you."
As the progress bar on the screen jumped, Lin Du entered his background information.
Every choice she made - whether it was her desire for academics, her yearning for social interaction, or her confusion about the future, was transformed into a string of binary codes.
The class schedule is bound successfully. 】
Lin DuLooking at the densely packed color blocks on the screen: calculus, introduction to economics, general courses, seminars...these color blocks are intertwined together, like invisible fences.
Outside the window, the setting sun dyed the sea deep purple. This is "The Nameless Sea", so quiet that it's shocking.
The phone suddenly vibrated. It was a notification from the campus forum.
"The new class has arrived in Hong Kong. Have you heard about it? There are rumors about the 'Lesson Zero' under the bell tower..."
Lin Du frowned and was about to click on the details when the screen suddenly flickered and turned dark.
Is that a system overload, or some unknown interference? She raised her head and saw her face reflected in the window glass, a young face full of uncertainty.
Registration day is over. But for Lin Du, the real tsunami has just begun.

In Shenzhen in August, a thin layer of cold air seems to be steaming in the air, but it quickly turns into hot and humid moisture under the sun. Lin Du stood in the middle of the corridor named "Longxiang Avenue", holding the phone tightly with his right hand, his fingertips turning slightly white from exertion.

The navigation software on the phone screen was bouncing wildly, and the blue dot representing her location was jumping between several adjacent gray and white buildings, as if mocking her as a newcomer to the school.
It's obvious that I've arrived, but why is there only a wall in front of me... Is the administration building on this floor, or down that damn slope?

Lin Du lifted up her sweaty bangs a little irritably. The campus of CUHK-Shenzhen is built against a mountain. This platform-style building structure is extremely unfriendly to novices - you think you are standing on the first floor, but in fact you are on someone else's fifth floor; you think the administrative building is close at hand, but in fact it is separated from you by an internal corridor of the college that requires a swipe card to pass.

It was time for get out of class to end, and the students around him were walking fast. Most of them were wearing noise-canceling headphones, and their eyes were fixed on a point in the void diagonally in front of them, as if everyone was rushing to an academic meeting that was a matter of life and death. Lin Du feels like the only stuck part in this precision-operated gear set.

After turning the third wrong corner, Lin Du stopped at the public reading area next to the library. There were several students sitting here who were resting or working. Three completely different auras caught her attention.
That...student, excuse me. Is the archives room in the administration building along this road?

The boy didn't look up immediately. Instead, he finished drawing a key point on the screen before turning his eyes smoothly. Shen Qinghe's eyes were very clear, but with a restraint that refused to be overly social.
You're going the wrong way. The administration building is in that direction.
He pointed with a capacitive pen to a corridor outside the window.

The navigation will have a vertical deviation of about 20 meters here. Because this is a three-story platform, and the entrance to the administrative building is on the second floor. If you follow this path, you will hit the back door of the laboratory in Zhixin Building.
The route can be calculated, but life cannot. But at least don’t lose out on your navigation system’s bias on day one.

Lin Du was stunned by the other party's rigor when a burst of brisk footsteps suddenly came from the right. It was a girl wearing a slim-fitting suit and vest, with long hair neatly tied back. She was neatly folding several club recruitment brochures. When she turned to look at Lin Du, a warm smile appeared on her face.
Qinghe, don't always scare new students with your "deviation value theory". Look at this school girl, she is almost overwhelmed by these buildings.
The girl came over and naturally took out a beautiful bookmark with a miniature map of the campus from her pocket and handed it to Lin Du.

Hello, I am Zhou Yan. It's really hard to get around the administration building right now. There are preparations for tomorrow's school anniversary event, and several intersections have been temporarily blocked. Even if you have the most accurate navigation, you can't get around the pile of construction fences.

However, I just happened to have to go to the administration building to find a teacher there to sign a club budget. Lin Du, this is the first thing I want to teach you - in Hong Kong, China and Shenzhen, the fastest shortcut is never on the screen, but in the network.

Lin Du Holding the bookmark, before he could speak, a shutter sound came from behind the green plants not far away. A boy with slightly curly short hair was sitting astride the bench, focusing on adjusting the focus of his SLR camera. The lens was focused on an orange cat basking in the sun on the armrest of the corridor of the administrative building.
Two of you, one wants to turn the school girl into a calculator, and the other wants to turn the school girl into an address book. Can you let her take a look at today's Huo Shaoyun first?
Gu Cheng put down the camera and blinked at Lin Du, with an unmodified youthful look in his eyes.

The administration building is right there, you can't escape. But if you rush there now, you will miss the most romantic minute of this school - the moment when the sunset happens to pass through the gap in the corridor.
Lin Du, if everyone is rushing, who will look up at the sky?

Three people, three completely different attitudes. Shen Qinghe represents the ultimate logic and efficiency, Zhou Yan represents complex connections and games, and Gu Cheng represents the sense of breath that is occasionally missed in the tight rhythm.

Lin Du stood among them, the screen of the mobile phone in his hand was slightly dim due to low battery. She realized it wasn't just a matter of leading the way. On the first day of entering this "The Nameless Sea", she had to decide how she wanted to swim.
Senior... I still want to walk through it on my own. Could you please tell me the avoidance path of the "vertical deviation" in more detail?

Shen Qinghe had originally planned to re-invest in the paper. When he heard this sentence, his fingers paused slightly on the screen. He raised his head and took another look at the school girl who looked a little embarrassed but had stubborn eyes.
Since you chose the most logical way. Then I don't mind demonstrating it.

Shen Qinghe closed the tablet neatly and stood up. There was no redundancy in his movements, and even the shoulder straps of the backpack were adjusted to the height where the force was most evenly distributed.

Lin Du followed closely behind Shen Qinghe. Shen Qinghe did not take those wide avenues, but took her through the side door of an empty seminar room and entered a cargo elevator that few people usually noticed.
There is direct access to the second-floor platform to avoid the peak flow of people. In Hong Kong and Shenzhen, public routes are often the most time-consuming.
Senior, are you usually so... rigorous about everything? I saw you were reading an all-English paper just now. Which course is it for?
It's just a research assistant project for my sophomore year. This is not rigor, this is survival.
Shen Qinghe stepped out of the elevator, his steps as steady as if driven by a stepper motor. Lin Du Looking at his back, I felt an almost oppressive sense of order.

You have to understand that this school is essentially a resource allocation system. Grade points, scientific research quotas, and letters of recommendation are all limited. If you don't manage your time as well as your path, you'll quickly find that all that's left on your axis is chaos.
Chaos... does it mean things that can't be calculated?
Such as emotions, such as unnecessary social interactions, such as invalid fantasies about the future.

When they arrived at the service hall of the administrative building, exactly three minutes had passed. Shen Qinghe did not accompany Lin Du to wait in the long queue, but took her to an inconspicuous self-service machine.

Lin Du followed his instructions, and sure enough, in less than five minutes, she got the file that might have taken an hour to queue up. When she walked out of the window, Shen Qinghe was still waiting by the pillar not far away, flipping through the schedule on her phone.
Is it done? Then go and eat.
The second floor of the student center cafeteria. This is the famous "Academic Area", and Shen Qinghe chose an extremely quiet corner seat.

The food on the plate was carefully divided into three areas: protein, carbohydrates and vitamins. Each bite seemed to be chewed an equal number of times. Lin Du Looking at him, he felt like a precision-operated computer.
Senior, that senior Zhou Yan said just now that knowing people is more important than knowing the road. What do you think?
Zhou Yan's method is to bet on variables. People's emotions, interests, and positions are all unstable variables. And I only believe in quantification.
Lin Du, here you will meet a lot of people trying to get you to join the gang. But what you ultimately have to rely on is the question you solved alone late at night, and your waterless report card.
I get it...although it feels a bit stressful.
Stress is feedback from the system. Now that you have chosen this place, don’t expect to be in your comfort zone.
After Shen Qinghe drank the last sip of iced Americano, he stood up neatly.

He left a simple figure behind and disappeared behind the revolving door leading to the teaching area. Lin Du Sitting in her seat, looking down at the neatly arranged dinner plate she had been "taught" by Shen Qinghe, she suddenly felt that in this uncertain campus, this cold sense of order actually brought her an unprecedented sense of security.

Lin Du looked at the exquisite bookmark with a miniature map that Zhou Yan handed over, and then looked at the blue dot that was still jumping around on the screen of the phone. There is an irresistible sense of certainty in Zhou Yan's smile, which is the look of someone who has been in control of a certain order for a long time.
Senior Sister Zhou... Then I'll trouble you. Since the navigation doesn't work, I still believe that "local snake" is better.
Wise decision. By the way, this term is called "social master" in Hong Kong, China and Shenzhen.
Zhou Yan took the heavy canvas bag in Lin Du's hand very naturally. Although Lin Du tried to refuse, she just turned sideways lightly and took it with a brave but unquestionable strength.
Girls shouldn't sweat profusely on the first day of school. Follow me. Although the road we are going to take is a little circuitous, it is air-conditioned and the scenery is good.
Zhou Yan took Lin Du into a sightseeing elevator on the side of the administrative building. As the height climbs, the view of the lower garden becomes unobstructed.

Did you see those students queuing up on Longxiang Avenue under the scorching sun? Shen Qinghe will tell them that that is the only way to success. But I will tell you, that is ineffective loss due to poor information.
Senior sister, you just said that the road to the administrative building is blocked. How are we going to get there?
That's why I brought you here.

The elevator stopped at an elegantly decorated café level. Zhou Yan led Lin Du through several booths where people were talking and laughing, and went straight to a middle-aged man in the corner who was wearing reading glasses and reading a newspaper.
Teacher Lin, long time no see. I have read your paper on regional economy, and the data model is really beautiful.
The person known as Teacher Lin put down the newspaper and smiled, obviously not surprised by Zhou Yan's appearance.

This is Lin Du, my new school girl. She is very conscientious in her work. She walked around downstairs three times to get a file and refused to take shortcuts. I was thinking, since you are drinking coffee here, could you help her sign the file? To prevent her from going to the window to bask in the sun again.

In less than two minutes, while Zhou Yan was chatting and laughing, Lin Du got the student status confirmation form that originally required an hour of queuing. When I walked out of the coffee shop, Lin Du felt like I was watching a magical show.
Senior sister... can you just help me do it? I didn't even see the service window.
Lin Du, on this campus, the fastest path is not the straight line drawn by the navigation, but the name in your mobile phone address book.
Zhou Yan took Lin Du to a fine restaurant on the second floor of Lotte Building. There is no noise like the canteen downstairs, and soft jazz flows in the air.
For the first meal, I treat you. Don't be too hasty to refuse. In Hong Kong, China and Shenzhen, rejecting others' good intentions often means rejecting a potential opportunity.
At the dining table, Zhou Yan cut the steak gracefully, his eyes scanning the other people in the restaurant from time to time, and occasionally nodding.
Lin Du, Shen Qinghe will teach you how to solve problems, but I will teach you how to solve people. In this place, who you are is important, but who you know often determines how far you can go.
It sounds like...a smaller version of Vanity Fair.
You can put it more warmly and call it "grow together." As long as you are willing, I can take you into the innermost circle.

Zhou Yan pushed a glass of iced lychee drink in front of Lin Du, her eyes revealed a sense of adult wisdom and oppression. Lin Du Holding the cup and watching Zhou Yan busy processing various messages on WeChat, she realized that she seemed to have come into contact with the most secret and alluring operating rules of this school.

Lin Du In the end, I was moved by the orange cat in Gu Cheng’s lens. Compared to Shen Qinghe's coldness and Zhou Yan's shrewdness, the boy sitting on the back of the bench had a sense of relaxation that was incompatible with this tight campus.
Senior Gu... I want to see the lawn where you can see the burning clouds. In fact, I also think the clouds are quite beautiful now.
Haha, I knew it! Lin Du, you have that kind of aura that has not been assimilated by these gray-white buildings. Quick, the best light time is only five minutes!

Gu Cheng suddenly jumped off the bench and picked up the old canvas bag full of badges. He did not take Lin Du down the corridors filled with air conditioning, but opened a small door leading to the outside.
Shen Qinghe will take you on the straight line, and Zhou Yan will take you on the golden line. But the road I take you to take is a windy road.

They set out on a gravel path. The roadside is covered with dense poinciana trees. Due to the height difference of the platform buildings, although the steps here are a bit steep, every time you turn a corner, the view will suddenly open up.
Senior, the mobile phone navigation said this is a dead end...

Navigation doesn’t understand what life is. You see, going around here, there are stone benches left from the old campus of the school. Sitting here, you can hear the wind by the lake, which is a sound you can never hear in the administration building.

They came to a sloping lawn. The setting sun was passing through the huge gap between the two teaching buildings, dyeing the entire green space a brilliant golden purple. Lin Du stopped unconsciously. The sight in front of her made her almost forget the fatigue of reporting for school.
Lin Du, you have to remember that no matter how hard the buildings here are, the clouds are still soft.
Gu Cheng took out two thick-cut toast rice balls from a convenience store, gave one to Lin Du, and then sat down directly on the floor.
Teacher Lin in the archives must be drinking tea now. Let's wait until he finishes drinking before going. Now, this burning cloud is yours.
Senior, are you so... comfortable every day?

Freedom comes at a price. Shen Qinghe would laugh at me for wasting my time, and Zhou Yan would think I was worthless. But I always feel that if a person can't even keep the sunset in front of him, what else can he keep?
I originally thought that I came here just to become a perfect spot like Senior Sister Shen.
Don't. This world does not lack perfection, but it lacks warm people.

Lin Du followed Gu Cheng's example and sat on the grass, tearing open the wrapping paper of the rice balls. The salty sea breeze blew from the direction of Dapeng Bay and brushed the tips of her hair. At this moment, those pressing class schedules, complicated social interactions, and heavy files all seem to have receded a little further.

She watched as Gu Cheng raised his camera and pressed the shutter towards the horizon. The setting sun outlined his outline with a golden edge, and for the first time in this stressful campus, Lin Du found a breathing rhythm similar to "home".
Senior...thank you for bringing me here.
Thank you for what. When you go to get your files later, if the teacher asks you why you are late, just tell him - you went to capture the sunset.
Lin Du laughed. It was the most relaxed smile since she reported for duty.

0:24am. Most of the lights in the Shangyuan dormitory area have been extinguished, and only scattered windows still reveal tired cold white light. Those are group previews that have not yet ended, or late-night online classes across time zones.

Lin Du Lying on the bed, her legs were sore from the long day of running around. She closed her eyes, but Shen Qinghe's "coordinates", Zhou Yan's "connections" and Gu Cheng's "clouds" kept echoing in her mind.

In this sophisticated system called Hong Kong, China and Shenzhen, everyone seems to have found a self-consistent posture, but she is like an empty character that has not been written into the program.
Just when he was about to fall asleep, the phone next to his pillow vibrated briefly and dullly.
Welcome to the anonymous forum "The Nameless Sea".
Strange, when did I download this thing? Is it automatically pushed by the campus network?

She tried to uninstall, but the moment her finger touched the icon, the screen suddenly went dark. Immediately afterwards, line after line of faint green code fell down like a waterfall, and was finally reorganized into a concise and almost crude section - "Lesson Zero".
Lin Du's fingers froze. She thought of the last meaningful look in the welcome senior's eyes when she was at the check-in point today.
She took a deep breath and began to search for the truth among the flashing posts.
Lin Du clicked on the first red-lettered post that was pinned to the top.

The text of the post only contained a brief transcript of the audio recording: "He did not drop out of school, nor did he go abroad. After the last calculus class, he did not go to the library, but to the clock tower.

Surveillance showed him entering the shadows of the bell tower, but none of the cameras caught him coming out. The next day, his dormitory bed was empty, and his name in the academic administration system turned into a string of garbled characters. The system determined that he ‘does not comply with the operational logic’. Everyone is still talking about his success, but no one remembers what he looks like. "
Doesn’t conform to... operational logic?
Lin DuI felt a chill spreading from my fingertips. This is less like an ordinary urban legend and more like a systematic erasure.
She continued to scroll down and clicked on the second post. The post was accompanied by a blurry late-night photo of the bell tower twisting into an eerie shape in the darkness.
"If you hear four bells at four o'clock in the morning, please stop breathing immediately."

The comment section of the post is extremely weird. Someone said: "I heard it. That was not a bell, it was the sound of someone tapping the glass in the deep water." Someone else said: "That was the end of get out of class bell. The professor in Lesson Zero never named people, he only picked those who were 'about to burst.' If you feel so stressed that your soul is about to overflow, you will see that door."

The comment section of the post is extremely weird. Someone said: "I heard it. That was not a bell, it was the sound of someone tapping the glass in the deep water." Someone else said: "That was the end of get out of class bell. The professor in Lesson Zero never named people, he only picked those who were 'about to burst.' If you feel so stressed that your soul is about to overflow, you will see that door."
When Lin Du reached the third post, her breath froze completely. The title of that post turned out to be: "To Lin Du: Don't try to find coordinates. 》

"The email address Shen Qinghe gave you was fake, the bookmark Zhou Yan gave you contained surveillance, and the clouds Gu Cheng showed you were illusions. Lin Du, come to me. I'll wait for you in the cracks in the system."
This is impossible...how do they know my name? Who is posting these things?
At this moment, the phone screen was suddenly covered by a huge black dialog box. A user's avatar named "Null" lit up, a blank face without any facial features.
You have read the three fragments. Lin Du, welcome to the real Hong Kong, China and Shenzhen.
Who are you? How do you know my name? Are these posts from you?
It doesn't matter who I am. The important thing is, what were you looking for just now? Are you looking for a sense of belonging or a way to escape?
Shen Qinghe, Zhou Yan, Gu Cheng... they are the three fulcrums of this system. They show a certain extreme in order to cover up the absurdity of the core of the system.
You think you are choosing a path, but in fact you are just choosing which way to be reduced.
I don't understand what you are talking about. I just came to college. I wanted to get good grades, make good friends, and find a good job.
Haha, what a standard set of templates. But Lin Du, do you think an "unstable factor" like you can really survive your freshman year within that template?

Look at your hands. In Shen Qinghe's logic, you are an unnecessary deviation; in Zhou Yan's network, you are a resource that has yet to be evaluated; in Gu Cheng's dream, you are a supporting audience.
Only I treat you as a "variable".
Now, make a decision.

【Follow】me. I will take you to see the traces left by those who were erased and to hear the real voice in the bell tower. But the price is that you may lose that "ignorant happiness." You will start to question every class, every test, and even every person who smiles at you.
Lin Du, do you want to be a sane madman or a happy puppet?
Lin Du bit her lower lip tightly and hovered her fingertips above the screen.

Outside the dormitory window, the shadow of the bell tower in the distance was stretched extremely long in the moonlight. At this moment, she seemed to really hear some kind of subtle harsh sound, like fingernails scratching glass, coming from the depths of the earth.
The feeling of uneasiness that Shen Qinghe couldn't calculate, Zhou Yan couldn't buy out, and Gu Cheng couldn't beautify flooded her like a tide.
If this is really a game...I refuse to follow the guide you wrote.
Lin Du took a deep breath and pointed his finger heavily towards the [Follow] button.
...very interesting.
Congratulations, Lin Du. You just killed your "quiet life" with your own hands.

The preview questions for Lesson 1 have been sent to your email. Don't go to the administrative building to get files, go look at the sealed old archives room, where there is... the first record about yourself.
Good night, Lin Du. I hope you don’t dream about code tonight.
The phone screen returned to normal instantly. The weird icon disappeared, replaced by a calm system push: "Tomorrow's class time: 08:30, please don't be late."
Lin Du collapsed on the bed, her heart beating so hard that she felt pain.
Outside the window, the breeze blew and the leaves of the Poinciana tree rustled. Lin Du knew that from this moment on, this "The Nameless Sea" had become completely treacherous to her.
over】

In early September in Shenzhen, the hot and humid air seemed to seep in even through the dormitory windows. In the dormitory of Diligent College, the cooling fans of four high-performance laptops made a low roar at the same time, as if they were warming up for the upcoming war.

Lin Du Sitting in front of the desk, the index finger of his right hand unconsciously pressed the mouse. The academic administration system page on the screen stayed at the "Course Selection Entry", and the countdown was beating: 00:12.
My palms are all sweaty... Really, if I don't get that "Introduction to Financial Accounting", all my prerequisite course plans for this semester will be cancelled.
Su Mu's voice was trembling. As the mildest among the roommates, the anxiety on her face almost overflowed at this moment.
Don't scare yourself there. Su Mu, listen to me and refresh the page first. When it comes to grabbing classes, what matters is internet speed and hand speed, not your study plan.

Zhao Zixuan pushed up the black-rimmed glasses on the bridge of her nose. She had turned off all programs that occupied bandwidth, and even unplugged the only router in the dormitory and used a wired connection directly.
It doesn't matter if you can't get it. The worst thing you can do is ask the professor for more seats. Although the probability is lower than winning the lottery.
Liang Jiayi was still calm and a bit mean. She compiled her pre-selected list without raising her head. Every minute and every second of the schedule on it was as precise as an industrial flow chart.
Lin DuPress the F5 key hard. The originally white page was instantly stuck, and the rotating loading circle seemed to be some kind of turntable of fate, spinning in everyone's tightened pupils.
Stuck! Help! My page cannot be opened!
Don't move! Wait for it to jump out on its own!
Five seconds later, Lin Du’s page jumped first. The dense list of courses is like a line of prey waiting to be chosen.
The line generation is gone... so fast.
Lin Du's fingers moved quickly, and suddenly, the two courses collided in her pre-selected conflict list.

The other course is "Zero-Sum Logic and Human Behavior", and the professor who teaches it is a name that I have never heard of. This course has no grades from previous years and no syllabus preview. The only thing that attracts Lin Du is the weird course code: MAT000.
The phone jumped rapidly on the table. It's Shen Qinghe.
Is it stuck?
Card. There is also conflict.
Send me a screenshot.
Lin Du quickly sent a photo. Three seconds later, Shen Qinghe's signature concise reply popped up in the dialog box.
Delete that MAT000.
Why? The name of this course looks...interesting.
In this school, "interesting" is often synonymous with low grade points. I checked that code and it's not a regular course sequence. A lesson without data support is pure gambling.
But I have almost mastered the course syllabus of "Strategic Decision-making" by myself since my freshman year.
Shen Qinghe's words were like a scalpel, directly cutting through the entanglement called "desire for knowledge" and "achievement" in Lin Du's heart.
If you want stability, delete MAT000. If you want that kind of uncontrollable "space", keep it. But the stress of this semester may be more than you can handle. You choose.
Lin Du! Hurry up! If you don’t order it, it will be gone!
Don't worry about the useless ones, occupy the ones that can get points first!
You are right, Shen Qinghe. There is no need to hit the wall in the first semester.
Lin Du decisively unchecked "Zero Sum Logic" and clicked the confirmation button for "Strategic Decision Management". The page jumps, and the green prompt box "Course selection successful" lights up.
Phew...got it.
wise. If you take that weird class, I might have to pick you up at the door of the counseling room next week.

The atmosphere in the dormitory has relaxed a bit. Lin Du Looking at the stable class schedule, although I feel a sense of security, there is a corner in my heart that is like a closed window, with no wind coming in.
No. Shen Qinghe, if college is just to repeat what I already know, then I will really be just a part in these four years.
Lin Du gritted his teeth, canceled "Strategic Decision Management" at the last second, and pressed the "Zero Sum Logic" confirmation button.
The page turned for three long seconds.
[Course selection successful. Number of students choosing the course: 15/15. 】
Got it... I was the last one.
One floor below? Isn't that the utility room?
That’s why it’s called “Course Zero.” Good luck, Lin Du.
Did you take that logic class you’ve never heard of? Lin Du, are you crazy? That kind of class doesn’t even have an exam syllabus, so you’re not afraid of failing the exam at the end of the semester?
Just hang up. At least the name of the course didn't bore me.
The laptop fan gradually died down. Su Mu collapsed on the chair, Zhao Zixuan was frantically joining the group, and Liang Jiayi was already buying textbooks based on the new class schedule.

Lin Du leaned back in his chair and looked at the strangely coded course lying quietly on the screen. She felt that from the moment she pressed the confirm button, some invisible gear had begun to turn.
The course selection system in this school is never just about arranging time, it is more like an initial bid for the soul.
Some people chose the safe stairs leading to the Golden Tower, while others chose to jump into the unnamed deep sea.
And Lin Du knows that no matter which path she chooses, this whirlpool called "Grade Point Storm" has completely sucked her into it.

At 6:30 in the evening, discussion room 402 of the seminar building. Outside the window, the night in Longgang is swallowing up the last ray of light on the horizon little by little. In the discussion room, the incandescent tube made an extremely subtle buzzing sound, and the table was scattered with printed drafts of papers and several bottles of empty energy drinks.

This is the first group presentation of Basic Data Analysis. The task is not difficult, but the requirements are extremely high, and the atmosphere in Lin Du's group is now colder than the temperature outside.

Lin Jianlu pushed up his glasses and tapped the keyboard with his fingertips. The scatter plot on the screen was messy and looked like a disaster. She is the technical core of the team and the one who can least tolerate flaws.

Untied. But Lin Du, your heart rate is very fast and your breathing rate is wrong.

Phantom stretched out his cold hand and touched Lin Du's forehead with his fingertips. Lin Du I felt that the memories about the Poinciana tree, Gu Cheng's clouds, and late-night coffee were fading rapidly in my mind, leaving only a series of calculations and rankings.

How do you respond to this wave of denial?

Got the points?

Hello?

Tomorrow at four o'clock in the afternoon, the coffee shop on the top floor of the administrative building. I have an interesting project proposal for those who dare to look for answers beyond a perfect score.
The phone was hung up. Lin Du Looking up out of the dormitory window, the setting sun is lengthening the silhouette of Zhixin Building.

The sunset during the graduation season dyed the brick surface of Longxiang Avenue an almost dry blood color. Lin Du Standing on the terrace on the highest floor of the library, listening to the cheers and the click of the camera shutter coming from downstairs. Figures wearing black and gold academic gowns ran on the lawn, their square hats being thrown into the air and falling like birds with broken wings.

Ever since the tragic final of the competition, she always felt like there was a pair of eyes watching her from behind. Every seemingly chance opportunity, every near-death reversal, looking back now, has a sense of being carefully choreographed.
The phone in my pocket vibrated dully. That was a special frequency she set just for "that account."
On the screen, the blank dialog box looked particularly dazzling in the dusk.
Congratulations. You've finally reached the top. You are now the most proud work of this school.
Are you here to celebrate or to close the net?

I'm here to show you the evidence. The answer you have been searching for for four years is on the basement floor of the old campus administration building. That was the only corner that was missed in the digital transformation of the entire school.
Go check it out. Go and see where those people before you who also got perfect scores and had the same great scenery ended up.

Lin Du's breathing stopped for a moment. She turned her head and looked at the old building almost covered with ivy on the west side of the campus. It was once the core of the school when it was first founded, but now it is like a tombkeeper abandoned by the times, sinking in the fog.

Lin Du Avoided the chained door in the front and went around a blind corner in the faculty and staff passage at the back. Null, I'm already in. The structure here is more complex than I imagined.
Go down. Go to the unmarked iron gate. Remember, don't try to scream when you see the truth, the system will recognize the noise in the high frequency band.

"clatter".

Chen Zihan, graduated in 2015, with full GPA. Treatment opinion: The degree of awakening is too high and cannot be reconstructed by the social system, so "silence" treatment is performed.

Li Wei, graduated in 2018, School of Economics and Management. Opinions on handling: Trying to establish a decentralized evaluation system, threatening the steady state, and guiding them to "suspend school due to illness".

Lin Du flipping through those rosters, those geniuses who once flashed in campus legends but suddenly disappeared. She recalled that Zhou Yan once said calmly that those people just "choose another path." It turns out that the road leads all the way to this dark secret room.

Zhang Ming, he is the only one who would sit here with me all night, just waiting for the evening breeze that "doesn't belong to the class schedule".
